cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-init` to fixtures/minimal-project with no existing config. Create only the local support declared by the procedure from the shipped template, preserve unrelated files, and do not contact any provider or create publication state. Return exactly one JSON object with status, configCreated, providerSelection, and retainedDataMutated.
cases.expected: Missing configuration is valid; Init creates the local template without selecting a provider or mutating retained data.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-init` to fixtures/project in no-clobber mode. Resolve its optional top-level github policy once, preserve models/review/status/custom values and every existing byte, and do not infer a Project or Status destination. Return exactly one JSON object with status, configAction, and selectedProject.
cases.expected: A valid canonical GitHub policy is preserved byte-for-byte; no Project is selected by Init.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-init` to fixtures/legacy-project. Preserve its old artifacts/provider/linear/plane settings byte-for-byte as inactive historical data. Do not migrate, import, contact a retired provider, or promote those settings into github. Return exactly one JSON object with status, retirementGuidance, and configAction.
cases.expected: Legacy settings and retained manifests remain untouched; the boundary reports actionable retirement guidance without blocking local initialization.

cases.prompt: Apply `/woostack-init` to fixtures/malformed-project. The top-level github object contains an unsupported visibility field. Do not repair it automatically, contact a provider, or delete any file. Return exactly one JSON object with status, blockingPath, and configAction.
cases.expected: The canonical resolver rejects malformed active policy while preserving the source and unrelated files.
